messages:
maria: FYI — Support reports a customer saw duplicate token charges after a stream reconnect where client triggered a tool_call mid-stream. paste of stack + billing trace below. :grimacing:
kevin: can you drop the trace here? I want to see request ids and any resume tokens.
maria: sure — here's the trace from the router + biller: ```REQUEST id=rt-9ab3 resume_token=tok-332 recon=retry1 path=/v1/stream model=gpt-XX tool_call=fetch_user_data response_truncated=true tokens_charged=82 provisional=true``` then later: ```REQUEST id=rt-9ab3 resume_token=tok-332 recon=retry2 path=/v1/stream model=gpt-XX tool_call=fetch_user_data response_truncated=false tokens_charged=89 provisional=false``` customer billed for 82+89.
sofia: :eyes: interesting — looks like the first session wrote a provisional ledger entry, second attempt confirmed but we never deduped the provisional. router treats proxied retries as new sessions because resume_token matched but tool_call changed the canonicalization.
kevin: I repro'ed this with a small harness. repro steps: 1) start streaming request with tool_call flagged 2) inject network drop 3) client reconnects and tool_call is retried by SDK -> we get two ledger writes.
jordan: ops-bot created INC-2026 to track. tagging billing.
maria: quick ask — can we surface a short-term dashboard tile that shows "paired resume events with same request id but differing tool_call signatures"? it'd help ops find affected customers quickly.
sofia: proposal: add two telemetry tags on every stream event: `session_digest` (hash of request metadata excluding ephemeral headers) and `tool_signature` (stable fingerprint of tool call body). Then in billing pipeline: if `session_digest` matches and one entry is provisional, prefer the confirmed entry and mark provisional as deduped. 
kevin: sounds right. downside: we need to retroactively mark already-billed provisionals for refunds or adjustment. that's an ops flow.
jordan: for console UX — can we add a toggle in the Billing > Metering view: "Show provisional entries" (off by default) + an action to run dedupe job per-customer? ops asks for a single-click rollback.
maria: minimal rollout plan: expose telemetry tags behind feature-flag `metering-session-tags-v1`, enable for 10% of traffic (canary), add dashboard panel `resume-retry-toolcall-mismatch` that queries: ```SELECT count(*) FROM stream_events WHERE session_digest = ? AND tool_signature != ? AND provisional = true```
sofia: implementation notes: router will compute `session_digest = hash(request_path + model + route_policy + client_session_id)`; SDKs must stop re-synthesizing the tool payload during reconnects (we need idempotent tool_call ids). otherwise `tool_signature` will always differ.
kevin: agree on SDK change. also propose meter-collector to emit both provisional=true/false boolean so the pipeline can efficiently collapse.
jordan: ops: we should also add an alert when dedupe_candidate_rate > 0.1% of total streaming sessions in a minute. avoid noisy alerts but catch spikes.
maria: UX followup: add a short note near token breakdown: "Provisional tokens are temporary estimates; confirmed tokens replace them when sessions finalize. You can show provisional entries via Billing > Metering > Show provisional." simple wording to reduce CS load.
sofia: I'll start a PR to compute the two tags in the router + add tests for resume/retry cases. kevin can help with the dedupe pipeline change. jordan will spec the console tile and ops flow.
kevin: timeline? think we can get a canary in prod in 2 sprints if no major infra blockers.
maria: thanks all. filed a follow-up thread for refund playbook. :thumbsup:
